steps.en: Install the extension and pick the model behind it
steps.zh: 装上扩展，选好背后的模型

steps.en: Pick the mode that matches the role you need right now
steps.zh: 按当下需要的角色挑一个模式

steps.en: Loads that mode's role prompt and its allowed tool groups into the same chat
steps.zh: 把该模式的角色提示词和允许的工具组装进同一会话

steps.en: Describe the job; save a repeated convention as a custom mode
steps.zh: 说清任务；要复用的约定就存成自定义模式

steps.en: Reads the workspace and proposes edits and commands, waiting for your approval
steps.zh: 读工作区，提出改动和命令，等你批准

steps.en: Switch modes mid-task as the job changes — plan, then implement, then debug
steps.zh: 任务性质变了就中途换模式：先规划，再实现，再排查

steps.en: Swaps the role and tools behind one continuing conversation
steps.zh: 在同一个持续会话背后换掉角色和工具

value.en: One conversation can plan, implement and debug without re-explaining the task to a fresh agent
value.zh: 一个会话里就能规划、实现、排查，不用把任务重讲给一个新 agent
